title: ujumbe pack index
description: index.json in a pack release, written by tool/build_release.dart and signed in index.json.sig. The engine (PackIndex.fromJson) is the authority; it ignores unknown fields so later formats can add them.

packs.description: One entry per pack in the release, sorted by id.

fileName.description: A release asset name, with no directory part.

min_engine.description: Oldest engine version that can read the pack, as in pack.yaml (default 0.1.0).

sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the exact pack file bytes.

file.description: Asset name of the pack file.

signature.description: Asset name of the pack's detached base64 Ed25519 signature.
